title: 第25章 血魔教七罪骑士不可能出现的突破第26章 震惊女教皇圣女破限级天才
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆

“老师慧眼如炬。”
洛凡尘睁眼起身，被对方一语道破，他也知道装傻充愣毫无意义，不如大方承认。
帝薇央绝美双瞳清澈透亮，笑骂道：“听半天了吧，你小子倒是挺沉得住气的。”
“您是说，师哥一直在偷听？”白莹玥讶然。
“呵，你这师哥，机灵着呢。”帝薇央唇角扬起，也不生气。
“所以老师您刚才说的很多话，都是特意给师哥听的？”白莹玥也很聪慧，迅速明悟过来。
帝薇央颔首：“既是对他，也是对你。”
“你身为圣女，不可整日嬉闹，该当也有自己的判断能力，不可被外人左右。”
“嘻，徒儿聪明着呐。”白莹玥甜甜一笑：“我啊，才不会被人骗。”
说话间，帝薇央扭转目光：
“凡尘，你这武魂煌煌大气，并无邪性，但若是不小心使用，肆意吸收血气、魂环，也容易堕入魔道，一定要加以克制。”
“在为师和莹玥面前使用尚可，但尽量不要让外人发现它可以吞噬生灵进化。”
“很多人的正义，只是死板的正义，又或是为了实现他个人利益的口头正义。”
声音句句冰冷，但洛凡尘不是小孩子，品得出这背后藏着关心。
洛凡尘点头：
“老师放心，徒儿明白。”
“捷径虽快，但上限不高，很容易走到尽头；苦修虽累，但这世间最累的路，往往是那可以走的更远的路。”
帝薇央闻言，神情一愣，仔细品味，望着洛凡尘的眼神愈发奇异。
这样的话，可不像是一个十六岁青年能说出来的。

每每所言，发人深省，这哪里是山野年幼之人可以领悟出的道理。
帝薇央内心暗道，看来不能将自己这个徒儿当孩子看待，他远比神殿内部许多执事长老还要成熟。
白莹玥倒是没想这些，脸蛋红扑扑的，她意识到刚才自己极力维护洛凡尘的一面，只怕被对方全都听了去。
臭师哥，竟然偷听！！
可恶啊。
“师妹，刚才仗义执言的事，谢了。”洛凡尘笑道。
看着洛凡尘嘴角溢出的潇洒帅气微笑，白莹玥脸蛋红的更厉害了。
她攥着小手，板起俏脸道：
“你不要多想哈，我只是因为你是我便宜师哥，可不是因为对你有多大好感才求情的。”
“明白，明白，师妹堂堂圣女，怎么会喜欢我这野小子呢。”洛凡尘揶揄道。
“哼！知道就好。”白莹玥傲娇的扬起下颚：“烤肉快糊了，本圣女现在没功夫理你！”
白莹玥走后，洛凡尘忍不住问道：“老师，不知道何为邪魂师？”
帝薇央道：“邪魂师尽皆是性格偏激，喜好杀戮之人，武魂千奇百怪。”
“但有一个共同的特征，他们的武魂可以吸食气血，吞噬神魂，提升自身实力。”
“往往杀戮越多，他们精神失常的就愈厉害。”
洛凡尘心里嘀咕，这不就是一群有实力的精神病嘛?
想想确实有点吓人。
话说他们要是发现自己武魂也有吸血能力，别再把自己当成病友、同类看待。
自家人知道自家事，他这可是混沌祖龙武魂。
什么邪魂师，滚远点，别来沾边。

不然指不定咱俩谁吸谁。
帝薇央凝重道：“等你学成出山以后，务必要小心，普通邪魂师不足为虑，但若是遇到血魔教的邪魂师格外谨慎。”
“血魔教？”洛凡尘诧异，难不成一群精神病还能有组织，有纪律的混在一起？
帝薇央点头，脸色难看。
“魂武大陆正道第一势力是哪家尚有争议，但血魔教是无可争议的邪道第一势力。”

"The teacher has a keen eye."
Luo Fanchen opened his eyes and stood up. After being told the truth by the other party, he also knew that there was no point in pretending to be dumb, so it was better to admit it openly.
Di Weiyang's beautiful eyes were clear and translucent, and she smiled and cursed: "I've been listening for a long time, you kid is quite calm."
"You mean, senior brother has been eavesdropping?" Bai Yingyue was surprised.
"Ha, you, senior brother, are very clever." Di Weiyang raised the corners of her lips, but she was not angry.
"So, teacher, a lot of what you just said was specifically for senior brother?" Bai Yingyue was also very smart and quickly understood.
Di Weiyang nodded: "Not only to him, but also to you."
"As a saint, you cannot play around all day long. You should also have your own judgment and cannot be influenced by outsiders."
"Hehe, my disciple is very smart." Bai Yingyue smiled sweetly: "I will not be deceived."
As she spoke, Di Weiyang turned her gaze:
"Fan Chen, your martial soul is so brilliant and has no evil nature. However, if you use it carelessly and absorb blood and soul rings arbitrarily, you can easily fall into the devil's path. You must exercise restraint."
"It's okay to use it in front of Master Wei and Yingyue, but try not to let outsiders discover that it can devour living beings and evolve."
"Many people's justice is only rigid justice, or verbal justice to achieve their own personal interests."
His voice was cold, but Luo Fanchen was not a child, so he could tell there was concern behind it.
Luo Fanchen nodded:
"Teacher, don't worry, my disciple understands."
"Although the shortcut is fast, the upper limit is not high, and it is easy to reach the end; although hard work is tiring, the most tiring road in the world is often the road that can go further."
Di Weiyang was startled when she heard this. She tasted it carefully and looked at Luo Fanchen with an increasingly strange look.
Such words are not something a sixteen-year-old can say.
Every time what he says is thought-provoking, this is not something that young people in the mountains can understand.
Di Weiyang secretly thought, it seems that she cannot treat her disciple as a child. He is far more mature than many deacons and elders in the temple.
Bai Yingyue didn't think about this, her face turned red. She realized that she had tried her best to defend Luo Fanchen just now, but she was afraid that the other party would listen to her.
Stinky senior brother, you actually eavesdropped! !
Damn it.
"Junior sister, thank you for speaking out just now." Luo Fanchen said with a smile.
Bai Yingyue's face turned red even more when she saw the handsome and handsome smile on Luo Fanchen's lips.
She clasped her little hands and said with a pretty face:
"Don't think too much about it, I'm just asking for mercy because you are my cheap senior brother, not because of how much I like you."
"I understand, I understand, how could my junior sister, a holy lady, like a wild boy like me?" Luo Fanchen teased.
"Hmph! It's good to know." Bai Yingyue raised her chin proudly: "The barbecue is almost burnt, I have no time to pay attention to you now!"
After Bai Yingyue left, Luo Fanchen couldn't help but ask: "Teacher, don't you know what an evil soul master is?"
Di Weiyang said: "Evil spirit masters are all people with extreme personalities and like to kill. Their martial spirits are all kinds of strange."
"But they have one common characteristic. Their martial souls can suck energy and blood, devour souls, and enhance their own strength."
"Often the more they kill, the more insane they become."
Luo Fanchen murmured in his heart, aren't these just a group of powerful psychopaths?
It's actually kind of scary when you think about it.
In other words, if they find out that their martial souls also have the ability to suck blood, they should stop treating themselves as fellow patients or fellow patients.
His family knows his own affairs, and he is the Chaos Ancestral Dragon Martial Spirit.
You evil soul master, stay away and don’t get involved.
Otherwise, we might not know which one of us will suck which one.
Di Weiyang said solemnly: "After you complete your studies and leave the mountain, you must be careful. Ordinary evil soul masters have nothing to worry about, but if you encounter an evil soul master from the Blood Demon Sect, you must be extra cautious."
"Blood Demon Cult?" Luo Fanchen was surprised. Could it be that a group of mentally ill people could still be organized and disciplined?rise?
Di Weiyang nodded, her expression ugly.
"It is still controversial which righteous force is the first in Hunwu Continent, but the Blood Demon Sect is the undisputed first evil force."
